svg.text: A3 The tool travels to a ribbon that never moves: the fixture stands on edge (schematic)
Left: looking along the conductors (Y into the page), 1 mm = 14 px, jaw sizes assumed. Right: plan of the table (Z out of the page).
End view: the working conductor drawn out of the ribbon's plane
side-puller finger (behind the jaw's rear face)
gantry Z plate (kinematic mount + pogo pins)
The jaw's long axis runs along the row (Z), so the anvil half spans the neighbours;
conductor k is drawn out in X until the anvil half's back face clears their boxes.
Plan of the table (gantry X-Y over a fixed bed)
conductor k, drawn out in X
module rack: crimp (SN-2549 or a4b head) | strip (Klein) | cut (flush cutters)
After the last conductor: the front plate squares
the noses, the rear clamp closes behind the
insulation crimps, and the housing slide pushes
the XHP onto the whole row. Every crimp comes out
upright, in cavity order; no stored feed.
